N=313 passes the min threshold but modality and longitudinal constraints eliminate this entity.

gaps.detail: Neither surviving candidate has explicit commercial-use clearance fully documented in the wiki. ADNI (strong match) has a base LONI DUA that permits commercial use per pricing-data.md, but the ADMC lipidomics sublayer commercial terms are unverified. ASPREE (partial match) is PI-request-only with no stated licensing terms. The orchestrator should flag this as a pre-commitment verification requirement for both candidates.

Both surviving candidates use targeted lipidomics (LC-MS/MS QqQ, 781 species), not broad untargeted metabolomics. If the buyer requires untargeted metabolomics covering amino acids, organic acids, TCA intermediates beyond lipids, neither cohort satisfies the scope. The request did not specify targeted vs untargeted — buyer should confirm.

Only 4 cohort entities exist in the wiki; 3 are AD-indication, 2 survive hard filters. The request space (longitudinal plasma metabolomics in AD, n>=200, commercial use) is much larger than the current wiki can answer. Orchestrator should evaluate triggering ingest for additional AD plasma metabolomics papers.

ASPREE partial candidate has no medication_and_lifestyle_confounders dimension covered (provenance_depth 0.14). Statin prevalence in an elderly Australian RCT population is expected to be high but is not documented in the wiki entity. This is a soft concern for ASPREE and a gap that buyer should ask PI to confirm.

The request did not mention MCI or prodromal AD. Both ADNI cohorts enroll MCI participants co-enrolled with AD — the buyer should confirm whether MCI-to-AD conversion sub-cohorts are acceptable, as they expand the usable analytical N and enable conversion prediction modelling.

verdict_reason: 1 strong candidate (adni-go2-plasma-lipidomics) and 1 partial candidate (aspree-dementia-casecohort-lipidomics) survive hard filters; the strong match is well-evidenced but has an unresolved ADMC sublayer commercial-use question and targeted-vs-untargeted modality scope gap; wiki coverage is thin (4 total cohort entities) and targeted lipidomics is the only available modality — orchestrator should decide whether to proceed with the 2 matches or trigger ingest for broader AD plasma metabolomics coverage.
